  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  FEBRUARY 27, 2018

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Winterer at 4:31p.m., on
Tuesday, February 27, 2018, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Ted Winterer
  Mayor Pro Tem Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Pam O’Connor (arrived at 5:00 p.m.)
  Councilmember Terry O’Day (arrived at 4:37 p.m.)
  Councilmember Tony Vazquez (arrived at 4:32 p.m.)

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  City Attorney Lane Dilg
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 4:31 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers O’Day, Vazquez, and O’Connor.

CLOSED SESSIONS  There was no one present for public comment on closed sessions.
Councilmember Vazquez
arrived at 4:32 p.m.  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 4:32 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 5:36 p.m., with all members present, to
Councilmember O’Day  report the following:
arrived at 4:37 p.m.
  1.A. Public Employee Evaluation
Councilmember O’Connor  Title: City Attorney
arrived at 5:00 p.m.
  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:36 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Ted Winterer
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  February 27, 2018
